end.summary: Practised recognising equal parts and naming halves, thirds and quarters.
end.parentNote: Nisha practised checking that parts are equal before naming a fraction, using roti and flag examples. They used dividing into equal groups to find one-third of a collection, including 1/3 of 9 and 1/3 of 15. They sometimes mixed up the part taken with the part left; this was clarified for the final 1/3-of-9 example, which they answered as 3. At home, share a roti or paper circle into equal halves, thirds, and quarters, then ask Nisha to name one part and explain why the parts are equal.
